items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: That was called “Jake Takes Manhattan” and it was supposed to be with Rosemary Clooney, although she didn’t show she got sick.

ctx.x: You had a couple of albums under your own name off and on?

Yeah I did. One was a mistake. That was called “Jake Takes Manhattan” and it was supposed to be with Rosemary Clooney, although she didn’t show she got sick. And so we just put it together as an album. It was all off the top of my head. We never rehearsed a note. But we did it as we went along. Carmen Leggio, a very, very fine player on that. Danny Stiles. Guys you never heard. But it was the first and sometimes the only record date with that company. And Mike Moore, and John Bunch. So we just threw it together.…
